why: Intro to Git and GitHub plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-git.json), 'Set up Git and make a repository' (passes: cookbook is a repository on a branch named main). The learner's older Git has no -b for init: `git init -b main` printed 'error: unknown switch `b'' and its usage. They ran plain `git init` ('Initialized empty Git repository in /Users/tripi/cookbook/.git/'), then `git checkout -b main` ('Switched to a new branch 'main''), and `git status` says 'On branch main' and 'No commits yet'. The repository is on main: done, after an error that changed nothing.

step.title: Make cookbook a repository on main
step.instructions: In the cookbook folder, run git init -b main, then git status. It should say On branch main and No commits yet.
